    </Sequence>
  </Retry>
</ReactiveFallback></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="hover_duration" min="1" max="15" initial="5" /><port name="max_wind" min="2" max="6" initial="4" /><port name="return_speed" min="1" max="6" initial="3" /><port name="return_timeout" min="10" max="60" initial="30" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Replaces the geofence guard with a ReactiveFallback. If the vehicle is blown outside the geofence, it will retry hovering until the wind subsides, then fly back towards the required goal.
